evidence: The frozen agent Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (both SHA256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1). Its line 1 uses the template versioned node:22-bookworm-slim base; lines 3 and 9-12 install exact express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 with matching NODE_PATH. Lines 14-23 copy only instructions/assets, set a+rX, and create a git-initialized empty /app; lines 25-26 set /app and sleep, with no startup installation. The documented Node/Express/better-sqlite3 runtime (integration.md:3-5, instruction.md:9) and reference manifest/imports need no additional server package. The versioned template base and unpinned apt packages are assessed under this supplied profile, without inventing a digest requirement or modifying template policy. Actual uncached task-layer build: local/uncached-build/agent.json records docker build --no-cache against the frozen environment directory, exit 0 in 65.922 seconds, image sha256:6e4ad5c882404af36e51d46a2b50b5ef373c14daf75536170338d7ece7d567f9. agent.log:243-246 shows the npm install executing, :255-272 staging/read permissions/git initialization, and :284 the matching image ID. The existing base image was retained; this is not a fresh registry-download measurement. Adversarial alternatives: a broken image with correct package metadata but a missing native SQLite binding could pass package-version-only inspection; the actual native SQL operation rules out that false positive here. A conforming app may use the declared global packages without a local node_modules tree; the actual Express/SQLite probe starts in the empty /app and succeeds, so local dependency files are not treated as an extra requirement. These are structural challenges supported by the positive image probe, not a claimed mutation regrade. No task source was changed.
